description: Defines classes and objects representing various reasons for executor loss or exit in Apache Spark's scheduler component.

classes.name: ExecutorLossReason
classes.description: Base class representing an explanation for executor or process failure or exit.

classes.name: ExecutorExited
classes.description: Represents an executor exit with an exit code, whether caused by the application, and a reason string.

classes.name: ExecutorProcessLost
classes.description: Represents a loss reason when an executor process is lost, including optional host info and cause.

classes.name: ExecutorDecommission
classes.description: Indicates that an executor is marked for decommissioning, with optional host info and reason.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory method to create an ExecutorExited instance with an exit code and cause flag, explaining the exit code.
